Get started

ABC — three agents, one loop

Architect, Builder, Craftsman. Three public orchestrators that turn intent into verified software.

//Architect

Maps an existing solution or designs a greenfield one, then scaffolds when you confirm.

/architect-solution-foundation

//Builder

Scopes a requirement into specs, gets your approval, then implements, verifies, qualifies, and ships.

/build-requested-change

//Craftsman

Turns durable quality findings into behavior-preserving remediation you can ship with confidence.

/craft-lasting-quality
See the workflow

Plain markdown. Any agent.

One copy-in command — no package in your project. AIDDbot works with the editors and agent harnesses you already use.

//Antigravity · Cursor · Devin · Kiro · VSCode · JetBrains · Zed

Compatible with any IDE that loads project context directly from your repository.

//ClaudeCode · Codex · Copilot · Composer · OpenCode

Works with every agent harness capable of reading or invoking skills.
